thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT 2213456789 — p95 latency SLO triggered multiple reroutes in us-west causing routing oscillation. Paging @oncall

nisha (oncall): I'm on. seeing p95 spike ~1.3s -> fallback policy kicking to eu-west then back to us-west repeatedly in past 8m. customers seeing elevated latency and a few error spikes.

jamie (sre): Confirmed. Metrics: internal-routing.reroute.count +420 in 10m, p95 token latency jumps aligned with each reroute. Looks like policy TTL/hysteresis isn't being respected when model-variant mismatch occurs.

matt (eng-runtime): Quick note — we deployed new model variants last night; some variants don't match the short-sequence optimized kernels, causing intermittent CPU backpressure. Fallback policy is preferring variant-compat over region-stable which is flipping?

nisha (oncall): @matt can you list which variant pairings cause this? need to know if we can pin callers to older variant.

matt (eng-runtime): It's between model-v1-q4 and model-v1-fp16. When us-west capacity hits threshold, router attempts eu-west:model-v1-fp16, but eu-west has a different sequence-len profile and backend warms slowly -> transient p95 spike -> router immediately flips back to us-west. Loop.

ashley (pagerduty): Paging followup — severity P1. Noted customer impact: several Enterprise customers reported UI slowdowns; no failed requests yet, but timeouts possible if loop continues.

leo (customer-ops): I'm compiling a short customer-facing blurb. ETA 10m. Which customers saw it?

jamie (sre): Top affected tenants: acme-fin, shopmate, convene-ai. They all route primarily to us-west. I'm seeing error rate up 0.8% for acme-fin coincident with the second reroute.

nisha (oncall): Initial mitigation plan: 1) pause automatic fallback for us-west (lock region) 2) increase routing hysteresis to 60s 3) pin acme-fin & top tenants to stable variant for 30m. Who can make those changes now?

matt (eng-runtime): I can push a temporary route-policy change: set fallback.enabled=false for us-west in the control-plane for 20m. Command: 
```
redwoodctl routing patch --region us-west --set fallback.enabled=false --reason "incident 2213456789 temporary lock"
```
I'll run that now.

jamie (sre): Also recommend enabling circuit-breaker on variant switch: min-stable-window=45s. That will prevent immediate flips. can someone update the runtime policy?

matt (eng-runtime): Patching circuit-breaker config now. Command: 
```
redwoodctl runtime update-policy --name "variant-switch" --set min_stable_seconds=45 --apply
```
Applying... ok 200.

nisha (oncall): matt — can you also pin acme-fin/shopmate to model-v1-fp16-stable? prefer to pin to the variant that showed lower p95 in recent traces.

matt (eng-runtime): Pinning acme-fin/shopmate now: 
```
redwoodctl customers pin-variant --customer acme-fin --variant model-v1-fp16-stable --duration 30m
redwoodctl customers pin-variant --customer shopmate --variant model-v1-fp16-stable --duration 30m
```
Pins applied.

leo (customer-ops): Draft blurb: "We observed elevated latency due to an automated fallback loop between regions after a model variant mismatch. We've temporarily disabled cross-region fallback for the affected region, applied stability tuning, and pinned high-traffic tenants to a known-good variant. Monitoring in progress." ok to send after we confirm? :thumbsup:

sarah (product): That looks good. Please include "no data exposure" and that we're prioritizing availability.

jamie (sre): Observability check: adding a short-lived alert: reroute.rate > 50/min for 5m -> notify eng-runtime & oncall. Setting now.

incident-bot: Change recorded: routing.policy updated by matt at 2213460100

nisha (oncall): Early signal: reroute.count dropped from 420 to ~6 in the last 5m after locks. p95 decreasing from 1.3s -> 520ms. Good.

ashley (pagerduty): Updated status: P1 -> investigating. Notifying impacted customers via support ticket queue.

matt (eng-runtime): Followup root cause note: our fallback scoring incorrectly prioritized variant compatibility score over region stickiness when capacity transiently degraded. The scoring formula had a missing tie-breaker on region_hysteresis_score. I'll open PR to make that explicit.

jamie (sre): Post-mitigation actions: 1) ensure fallback.enabled default=false for single-region heavy tenants 2) add 2x hysteresis window in router scoring 3) deploy canary of PR to staging and monitor for flip counts.

nisha (oncall): Handoff — I'm heading offline in 20m. jamie take over if anything resurfaces. jamie can you confirm acceptance?

jamie (sre): I'm taking on-call. I've set my slack status and will monitor dashboards.

leo (customer-ops): Sending the blurb now to impacted customers and linking this thread.

incident-bot: Pagerduty: Incident 2213456789 acknowledged by nisha (oncall) at 2213456795

matt (eng-runtime): Opening PR now: "router: prefer region_hysteresis tie-breaker when variant scores close" — will request review from jamie.

sarah (product): After-action ask: can we prepare a brief runbook for fallback misfires? customers asking for SLA explanation.

jamie (sre): Will draft a short runbook and paste here. Also adding retrospective ticket.

nisha (oncall): Final note before handoff: monitoring shows steady improvement, no new reroutes in past 6m, p95 ~480ms. leaving pager to jamie.

jamie (sre): Confirmed. I'm on for the next 4h. closing immediate mitigation, leaving pinned variants and circuit-breaker for 30m. Will revert locks once stable.

incident-bot: Incident 2213456789 status change: Mitigated -> MONITORING at 2213460523

leo (customer-ops): Thanks team. I'll update the customer ticket with the mitigation summary and next steps.
